method.excludedRuns: Exploratory and intermediate corrected runs, including those still granting quest completion, are excluded. Final corrected runs were sequential with no test/build workload during measurement.
method.sourceVerification: Every runtime source file compared byte-for-byte with the common assembled engine plus original PR4 or final submitted overlay; all four harness hashes match. Missing legacy sourceSha256 fields in raw reports are supplemented by verifiedProductionCommit.
method.sourceTreeHashFormat: SHA256 of sorted relative src paths + NUL + binary SHA256(file), concatenated.
method.accessPolicyChange: Baseline manager gives all fresh bots completed quests/access. Corrected manager leaves defaults and saved flags untouched; native Femi access can subsequently be earned. This intended difference changes eligible activities.

measurementNotes: Requested-tile arrivals include repositioning; they are not unique completed task destinations.
Activity-state frames include social tasks/waits. Native-script XP and frames provide separate productive-action evidence.
Native-script XP excludes legacy task-switch XP; other unrelated reward/startup policies are unchanged.
No Agility task completes its ten-lap target in these runs; transition displacement counters also include gangplanks and are not lap counts.
All raw report fields, including per-bot stats, are retained. Bot objects are compacted to one line to keep the artifact reviewable.
Quest audits load every CRC-verified save without BotManager initialization, world ticks, or saving.
